title: Stripe USD and EUR invoice amounts render as localized currency
verifies: USD total 10000 and EUR total 15050 render as $100.00 and €150.50 with no raw minor-unit integers leaking.

title: JPY invoice amount renders as zero-decimal currency
verifies: JPY total 5000 renders as ¥5,000 (zero-decimal) rather than an over-scaled ¥50.00.

title: A mixed-currency invoice list formats each row independently
verifies: A single list with USD and JPY invoices renders $100.00 and ¥5,000 side by side using each currency's own scale.
